assets.prompt: Production game background asset only, no UI, no text, no labels, no people, no mascots. Warm ivory and muted sage Pocket palette with charcoal plum accents, Singapore setting. Front-facing room slight isometric depth, wide 16:9 composition, clear foreground centre for a separate player sprite, large clear window on left behind room. No blur, no photographic textures, no 3D rendering. Full bleed opaque background. A Singapore secondary school classroom in late morning: pale cream walls, wooden student desks, dark green chalkboard to right, school bags, ceiling fan, wide tall windows on left with HDB blocks and tropical trees, soft clouds. Open space foreground middle.

assets.design: Pixel-art interpretation of Singapore's current Portrait Series front composition: Yusof Ishak portrait on the right, pale left panel, engraved denomination typography, ornamental linework and SINGAPORE at the bottom. Lavender SGD2, red SGD10, blue SGD50 and orange SGD100. Every note prominently marked SPECIMEN and GAME NOTE; no usable serials, legal-tender wording, authentic signatures or security-feature simulation.
assets.referenceTreatment: Official MAS specimen front images for SGD2, SGD10 and SGD50 visually inspected and used as ImageGen composition references. The SGD100 image endpoint returned maintenance; its orange palette and shared Portrait Series design were confirmed from the official text.
assets.treatment: Original transparent generated image preserved. SVG source-pixel viewBoxes frame each note without raster modifications.
